Let them know.|The sentry and Kleya Marki|audio=Sentry-Marki-MIS.flac|}} A [[human]] [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[ISB tactical agent|tactical agent]] served as a '''sentry''' in the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] when the wounded [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]] was [[Prisoner|incarcerated]] there in [[1 BBY]]. The sentry prevented Rael's disguised assistant, [[Kleya Marki]], from traveling higher than the seventeenth floor in a [[turbolift]], but she proceeded on foot instead and [[Death|killed]] Rael. ==Biography== [[File:Faiza-Kleya-Sentry-MIS.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A disguised Kleya Marki stand behind a med-glide wheelchair in which Faiza sits, both of them looking at an armored Imperial Security Bureau sentry in a white-walled room at the Lina Soh Hospital.|Marki abandoned Faiza after a sentry halted their progress.]] A [[human]] [[ISB tactical agent|tactical agent]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]] was stationed as a sentry in [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' after the injured [[Luthen Rael]]—[[Prisoner|imprisoned]] leader of the rebel [[Axis network]]—was put on [[life support]] there in [[1 BBY]]. The sentry was stood by a [[turbolift]] on the [[Medcenter|hospital's]] seventeenth floor when [[Kleya Marki]], Rael's assistant, arrived in the lift while disguised as a [[nurse]] and pushing the patient [[Faiza]]{{Databank|faiza-granny|Faiza ("Granny")}} in a [[med-glide wheelchair]].{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{AD|Disney+}} The sentry informed Marki that she could proceed no higher without special access, apologizing but not budging when Marki claimed that Faiza's [[Gender|daughter]] was on the nineteenth floor. Marki then loudly told the elderly Faiza that they would check in on the seventeenth floor and wheeled her away. However, once out of the sentry's view, Marki abandoned Faiza and proceeded on foot to the nineteenth floor through a surgery entrance,{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} eventually [[Death|killing]] Rael. The hospital was then placed on lockdown. ==Personality and traits== The sentry had light skin and brown [[hair]]. ==Equipment== The sentry wore a [[Color|black]] [[ISB Tactical]] [[Clothing|uniform]] with a set of white [[armor]] and a matching [[kama]] over it. They also had a black [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]] and carried a [[blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== The sentry was portrayed by [[Barney-Joe Jones]] in "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified ISB sentry}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=იუბ-ის უცნობი დარაჯი }} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:ISB tactical agents]]
